useCases.title: Windows Update Compliance
useCases.value: Unpatched systems are primary attack vectors. Tracking patch compliance across the fleet supports vulnerability management and regulatory requirements.

useCases.title: Software Update Compliance
useCases.value: Unpatched macOS endpoints are vulnerable. Tracking update levels across the fleet supports vulnerability management.

useCases.title: Backup Job Success Rate
useCases.value: Failed backups leave systems unprotected. Tracking success rate ensures recoverability and compliance with data protection policies.

useCases.title: Immutable Backup and Ransomware Recovery Readiness
useCases.value: Immutable or air-gapped copies are the last line of defense against ransomware. Verifying immutability and recovery procedure readiness ensures backups cannot be deleted or encrypted by an attacker.

useCases.title: Major Incident and Post-Mortem Tracking
useCases.value: Tracking major incidents and post-mortem completion ensures learning and accountability. Supports compliance and continuous improvement.
